diff.title: Why Larmony instead of a spreadsheet

d1.title: Truly multi-user
d1.desc: It's not a shared spreadsheet: each member has their own login, and the owner controls who joins and leaves the home.

d2.title: Exact cents
d2.desc: Every amount is stored in whole cents — no rounding. If the bill came out to R$ 33,33 for each person, that's exactly what shows up.

d3.title: Data isolated per home
d3.desc: Each home is isolated in the database (RLS): a member of one home can never see another home's data. No card data stored locally — payments run through Stripe.

proof.title: The end of lost spreadsheets and "who paid for what?"
proof.description: A single source of truth, clear for the whole family — whoever joined yesterday reads the dashboard the same way the person who created it does.

pricing.title: Simple and transparent

q1.question: Does Larmony have a free plan?
q1.answer: Not a permanent free plan, but everyone starts with a 30-day free trial of the Complete plan (card required, no charge until the trial ends). After that, you choose between Essential (R$ 9,90/month) and Complete (R$ 19,90/month).

q2.question: What's the difference between Essential and Complete?
q2.answer: Essential covers the core: transactions, default categories, goals, dashboard and monthly report, with unlimited members and homes. Complete adds budgets by category, scheduled entries, advanced reports (annual view and CSV export), and custom categories.

q3.question: Can I cancel anytime?
q3.answer: Yes. Your subscription is managed through Stripe's secure portal, with no penalty. You keep access until the end of the cycle you've already paid for; after that, your data stays available in read-only mode until you subscribe again.

q4.question: Do I need to connect my bank account?
q4.answer: No. Larmony works with manual entries and automatic recurrences — you control exactly what goes in. Open Finance integration is on the roadmap for a future plan.

q5.question: Is my financial data secure?
q5.answer: Yes. Each home is isolated in the database (RLS) — a member of one home can never see another home's data. Your password is encrypted, and payments are processed by Stripe, with no card data stored in Larmony.

q6.question: Does it work in other languages?
q6.answer: Yes — Larmony is available in 7 languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, Chinese, German, French, and Japanese). Each person chooses their own language and sees the same home translated, including reminder emails.
